title: Recommendation System Competition Platform (CS145-RecSys)
summary: A data-mining course competition platform built on the Sim4Rec simulation framework, where students design recommendation algorithms evaluated on simulated user-item interactions over multiple iterations. The platform's vendored Sim4Rec modules generate synthetic user/item data and evaluate results by importing CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula and TVAE from sdv.tabular and evaluate from sdv.evaluation, making SDV the underlying synthetic-data engine bundled inside the Sim4Rec code it carries in-tree.
